name: Pension Schmied im Tal
beschreibung:
Overview

Pension Schmied im Tal is a traditional inn with an attached guesthouse in the hamlet of Schmiedtal in the municipality of Thiersee in the Tyrolean district of Kufstein. The house sits at around 623 metres above sea level in the quiet Thiersee Valley and is surrounded on all sides by the Tyrolean mountains. As an inn it offers a cosy atmosphere with traditional charm and hearty home-style cooking. Here guests enjoy down-to-earth hospitality and a quiet location away from the hustle and bustle. The hamlet of Schmiedtal is one of the villages of the large municipality of Thiersee. The accommodation is well suited as a starting point for getting to know Thiersee and the surrounding landscape of the Kufstein region. The address is Schmiedtal 15, 6335 Thiersee, Tyrol.

History/Background

The available sources provide no reliable information about the origins and age of the establishment; the house is simply listed as an inn or guesthouse in Thiersee. The hamlet of Schmiedtal, where the accommodation is located, belongs to the municipality of Thiersee in the district of Kufstein. The surroundings are rural in character and shaped by agriculture, forests and mountains. In the valley lies the Thiersee, the body of water to which the municipality owes its name.

Getting there

Thiersee lies in the Kufstein region, around five kilometres west of the district town of Kufstein. The journey usually leads via Kufstein and from there along the road up the valley into the Thiersee Valley; the hamlet of Schmiedtal lies further along the course of the valley. Kufstein can be reached via the Inntal motorway A12 as well as via the railway line in the Inntal. More precise details about parking facilities or connections to public transport directly at the establishment are not documented and are therefore not given here.

Tips

The Thiersee Valley is a hiking and leisure area. From Schmiedtal, tours lead among other things to the Korinusklamm, a gorge known as a place of power, as well as to the surrounding peaks. Mountain bike routes such as the circuit over the Sonnberg also run in the surroundings of Thiersee. Anyone arriving by their own car should find out about parking facilities in advance. For those seeking peace and quiet, the secluded location in the valley is an advantage.

Best time to travel

The Thiersee Valley can generally be visited at any time of year. In the warmer months, hiking and cycling take centre stage; the snow-free months are ideal for extended mountain tours. In winter, winter sports and snowshoe hikes are possible around Thiersee, as the Thiersee Valley has a winter sports landscape. A specific, documented season for the guesthouse is not recorded, so there is no restriction here.
